metrics.name: descent_rate_fps
metrics.notes: Calculated from v_term = sqrt(2*m*g / (rho * Cd * S0)) using exact inch 0.0254m: S0 = pi * 0.6096^2 = 1.16745403 m^2, v_term = 9.258218 m/s = 30.374731 fps

expected.notes: Flat circular parachute nominal area descent rate at sea level

source.title: Parachute Recovery Systems Design Manual (Knacke 1992)
source.citation: T. W. Knacke. Parachute Recovery Systems Design Manual. NWC TP 6575, Chapter 5.
source.derivation: v_term = sqrt(2 * m * g / (rho * Cd * S0)) using exact inch conversion D = 48 * 0.0254 = 1.2192 m, S0 = pi * (D/2)^2 = 1.16745403 m^2, Cd = 0.80

comparison.decisionRule: Descent velocity must match independent first-principles derivation within 0.01% and kinetic energy within 0.02%

notes: Approved bounded analytic benchmark 2: 48in nominal area terminal descent at sea level
